name: Galen's Escape
summary: Galen Goodward is in the Fallow Sanctuary, begging for rescue from the creatures there, and promises a great treasure to anyone who gets him out. It waits in a locked strongbox at his camp north of Stonard.

sections.title: A Plea for Rescue
sections.body: Galen Goodward cries out that the creatures around him are going to eat him. Anyone who helps him out of danger is promised a great treasure. It sits at his camp, out in the swamp north of Stonard, locked in a strongbox that opens only through a trick known to Galen alone. If you help him escape, he will teach it to you.

sections.title: At the Strongbox
sections.body: At the camp you find the strongbox's keyhole filled with black resin, so it cannot be opened that way. But Galen told you of a latch hidden on the bottom of the box. A quick search finds it, and flipping it opens the strongbox.

faq.answer: Someone held in the Fallow Sanctuary who fears the creatures there will eat them, and who offers a great treasure to anyone who helps them escape.
In the swamp north of Stonard, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why can't the strongbox be opened in the usual way?
faq.answer: Galen's treasure is locked in a strongbox that opens only through a trick that Galen alone knows, which Galen will teach to whoever helps him escape.
